body: SUCCESSOR REVIEW: 7ba9356 closes the view/recall identity, one-effective-set, absent-anchor, and Credence findings. Formal block is now narrowed to one item. New section 8 itself says M9 can pass while published AblationResult loses provenance, but it adds no required carrier relation and no mutation for that publication loss. Freeze original checked-bundle identity plus typed removal policy/channel plus derived ablated-output identity on AblationResult or a content-addressed companion, and add the fixed-numerics drop/substitution mutation. Also widen section 10 source checklist beyond candidates.scala to the cited Estimate and hsmm sites. No other finding remains.
